messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-8921. Channel: #eng-oncall. Summary: KMS decrypt failures and 429 throttles observed for hosted-api (us-west1). Auto-escalation to oncall. Links: https://pagerduty.example/INC-8921 :rotating_light:

olivia (oncall): acked via PagerDuty (olivia). I'm seeing a spike in 5xx from the API gateway and logs showing KMS errors. Starting runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/kms-rotation-check :point_up:

olivia (oncall): quick logs (filtered):
```
2026-03-14T02:34:10Z ERROR KMSClient Decrypt failed; error=429 Rate exceeded
2026-03-14T02:34:12Z ERROR RequestHandler DecryptError key=projects/redwood/keys/ephemeral-2026-03-14 not found
2026-03-14T02:34:14Z WARN Router retrying request id=abc123 attempts=1
```

raj (sre): I see the scheduled key rotation job completed ~16m ago: rotation-job-1773. Can you confirm the new key material is published to the alias? If rotation partially failed clients may hit 'key not found'.

olivia (oncall): checking rotation job output now. Running: `kubectl logs job/rotation-job-1773 -n infra` -> getting a bunch of "publish to alias failed: 429" messages. Looks like the KMS provider is throttling during the publish step.

sam (support): getting customer reports: two enterprise customers (CUST-128 and CUST-402) opened tickets about 5xx on calls started ~02:32Z. SLA-facing. Logged in Zendesk: ZD-9987, ZD-9988. Triage: high.

maya (security): any signs of key compromise or unauthorized rotations? We need to be certain before rolling back.

olivia (oncall): no signs of compromise in audit logs — rotation triggered by internal pipeline at 02:12Z. This looks like a rate/availability issue at the KMS provider during alias publication. No unknown principals.

raj (sre): mitigation plan (short):
1) Route decrypts to fallback alias that points to the previous key version (safe read-only path)
2) Pause further rotations (rollback pipeline)
3) Request temporary rate limit bump from cloud provider or slow down rotation publisher (throttle client)
4) Notify customers and support

olivia (oncall): I'm enabling fallback alias now. Command (internal admin UI): `POST /admin/kms/alias/swap` payload `{"alias":"redwood/hosted-default","target":"ephemeral-previous"}` — doing it in console (will post status).

incident-bot: PagerDuty update: INC-8921 acknowledged by olivia at 1773000463; Escalation policy waiting 10m before next escalation.

olivia (oncall): swap completed — alias now resolves to ephemeral-previous. Immediate effect: error rate dropped from ~12% -> ~2% in the last 30s. Monitoring: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/8921 :white_check_mark:

sam (support): updating customer tickets: telling customers we're routing to fallback key and continuing investigation. Will offer credits where appropriate.

maya (security): thanks. Please keep audit trail of alias swap and rotation job logs. We'll review the rotation pipeline for safety checks.

raj (sre): I'll open a CR to add exponential backoff + jitter to the rotation publisher and limit concurrent publishes to 2. Also will request rate limit increase with the cloud KMS team — I've pasted the support request draft: 
```
Subject: Temporary quota bump request - KMS publish operations
Body:
- Project: redwood-prod
- Issue: alias publish operations are throttled during automated rotation, causing failed publishes and partial key availability
- Request: increase publish QPS from 10 -> 50 for 2 hours while we remediate
```

noah (next-oncall): I'm standing by to take the next handoff. ETA 30m; will monitor PD and metrics.

olivia (oncall): handing off to noah in 30m. Current status: fallback in place, error rate mostly back to baseline but still seeing occasional 429s from rotation pipeline. Support notified, customers updated. Running elevated alert for 2hr.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: escalation timer set for INC-8921; next escalation at 1773001063 if not resolved.

raj (sre): I've queued a rollback of the automated rotation pipeline for runs with publish errors; will also add a safety gate so rotation won't proceed if alias publish returns non-2xx for >1 instance.

sam (support): customers CUST-128 & CUST-402 acknowledged update; both flagged as 'impacted'. Support will open CSAT follow-ups once incident resolved.

maya (security): please attach all logs & audit entries to the incident record (IR-2026-23). We'll want a timeline: rotation start, publish failures, alias swap, customer tickets.

olivia (oncall): attaching logs to IR-2026-23 now. Final quick note: if we see recurring "key not found" after fallback, route traffic to the dedicated keyserver in us-east1 as secondary. I'll leave runbook steps in the incident doc.

noah (next-oncall): I'm taking over active monitoring. Next steps: confirm cloud provider rate bump request, complete pipeline patch (backoff), schedule post-mortem and assign actions. I'll update this thread at handoff.

incident-bot: INC-8921 status changed to 'Mitigated' at 1773002147 by olivia (note: mitigation = traffic routed to fallback alias). PagerDuty: awaiting resolution and postmortem.

noah (next-oncall): confirmed mitigation still holding at 1773002150. Creating incident ticket in tracker and assigning owners: postmortem owner = raj, action owner = olivia, support follow-up = sam.

olivia (oncall): leaving summary in the incident doc. Handoff complete. :handshake:

noah (next-oncall): acknowledged, monitoring continued.
